newsitem.title: UK: H.K. STOCKS IN LONDON END STEADY, WHIPSAWED BY DOW.
newsitem.headline: H.K. STOCKS IN LONDON END STEADY, WHIPSAWED BY DOW.

text.p: Hong Stocks in London ended steady to slightly higher on Wednesday, fluctuating with the volatility on Wall Street, traders said.
"There was huge volatility but with not that much traded," one dealer said.
"It was weak on the back of Wall Street last night and before the figures out of the States and then it was quite active," as the Dow industrials rallied sharply then turned back lower, he said.

The Hang Seng London Reference Index gained 6.7 points or 0.04 percent to 16,489.63. The index in Hong Kong gained 0.61 percent as selling dried up in the property sector and bargain hunters pushed prices higher.
Banking powerhouse HSBC Holdings slipped to HK$273.90 from $274 and China Light ended unchanged at HK$43.70.
